previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h~7-9, w~9-11) with 2-3 'X-QUAD' patterns. Each quad: color-2 cells at the FOUR diagonal corners of a 3×3 region (positions (r,c), (r,c+2), (r+2,c), (r+2,c+2)) — the center (r+1, c+1) and edges are 0. Quads are isolated by ≥3 cells from each other. Rule: for every cell (r, c) in the grid: if input[r][c] == 0 AND all 4 DIAGONAL neighbors (using safe-at with default 0) are 2 → output 1. Else preserve input. Net effect: the 0 center of each X-quad becomes color 1 (blue); everything else stays.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The complete stage-one grid and its input-dependent set of newly blue X centres.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Apply the exact canonical pass: every zero cell with red (2) in all four immediate diagonal positions becomes blue (1).
sequential_dependency.step_b: On the stage-one grid, recolour a red cell green (3) exactly when all four immediate diagonal neighbours are blue.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The source inputs contain no blue cells. Step B therefore has no eligible target before Step A; which red cells become eligible varies with the X centres Step A actually creates. Skipping Step A removes that support and changes every retained final output.
